args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24%, highlighting the scale of the returns challenge in retail logistics.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%), showing the value of centralising returns processing.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin, making speed of resale a key lever for profitability.

Sources: https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns and its companion piece at https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion
args.title: Retail Returns: Combined Summary (Saltmarsh Blog + Companion)
